definitions.explanation: Successfully maintaining or achieving two things at the same time, especially when they seem difficult to combine. Commonly used for work-life balance, studies and hobbies, career and family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{両立|りょうりつ}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両立|りょうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: Balancing studies and club activities is tough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}{保護|ほご}→環境保護：15308_kankyouhogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両立|りょうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}{社会|しゃかい}→現代社会：11501_gendaishakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: Balancing economic growth and environmental protection is a major challenge for modern society.

notes:
{両立|りょうりつ} implies successfully managing two things that are typically hard to combine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{両立|りょうりつ}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (balance A and B)
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両立|りょうりつ} (the coexistence of A and B)
- {両立|りょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ (hard to balance both)
- {両立|りょうりつ}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (can balance both)
